jackhp95/tailwind-m3e-web (PRIVATE repo, not on npm) — vendored CSS only. version 0.1.0

Upstream:  https://github.com/jackhp95/tailwind-m3e-web
Commit:    a3414c3  ("Merge branch 'fix-root-vs-html-specificity'")
Vendored:  2026-09-19

Same pattern as the two other consumers on this machine:
  - compass-social/web/vendor-web/tailwind-m3e-web/
  - buildoc/frontend/vendor-css-tailwind-m3e-web/

The package is private and unpublished (`npm view tailwind-m3e-web` → 404),
so vendoring the CSS is the only way to consume it. `src/` and `generated/`
are the two published-file trees; the generator scripts, tests, CI and drift
gate stay upstream.


REGENERATED, NOT COPIED
-----------------------
`generated/utilities.css` and `generated/CSS_CUSTOM_PROPERTIES.md` are NOT
the upstream committed artifacts. Upstream generated them against
@m3e/web 2.5.14; this repo pins @m3e/web ^2.7.12. That drift is real and was
measured, not assumed:

    2.5.14 → 2254 @utility rules
    2.7.12 → 2362 @utility rules   (+108 rules, 124 changed lines)

So the two files here were regenerated in place by running upstream's own
`bin/generate-component-utilities.mjs` against this repo's installed
`node_modules/@m3e/web@2.7.12/dist/custom-elements.json` — the exact input
the script expects. The generator is deterministic (re-running on the same
manifest is byte-identical), so this stays reproducible.

`src/` IS an unmodified upstream copy. Upstream's peer range is
`@m3e/web ^2.5.0 <3`, which 2.7.12 satisfies, and the token layer does not
depend on the manifest at all.

TO RE-SYNC after an upstream change or an @m3e/web bump:
  1. Pull upstream tailwind-m3e-web.
  2. Point its node_modules/@m3e/web at this repo's installed copy.
  3. `node bin/generate-component-utilities.mjs`
  4. Copy `src/` verbatim and the two regenerated `generated/` files here.
  5. Update the commit hash and rule count above.

Ideally step 3 happens upstream and is committed there, so upstream's own
drift gate (`bin/check-drift.mjs`) stays meaningful for all consumers.
